findings.summary: The fix does not cover the resumed path the task describes. `enforceReviewerCoverage` is only called from `finalizeReview`. The resumed (nothing-to-spawn) rounds build their verdict with `aggregateRound(prep.verdicts, ...)` followed by `attachVerdictRecordDraft`, in next-step.ts line 613 and workflow/execute-host.ts line 385; neither calls the new function. A resumed round carrying only a prior correctness-reviewer approval against required correctness+security still produces approved: true and ships with coverage.satisfied: false (the #2413 incident). AC1 unmet for the motivating case. Fix: call enforceReviewerCoverage at both nothing-to-spawn sites, after aggregateRound and before afterVerdict.
